scaffolded.kill_criteria: YAGNI a escala 2-3 consumidores el modelo por-elemento cuesta mas que el drift; el etiquetado por elemento no se mantiene; la deteccion semantica tiene demasiados falsos positivos a escala

critiqued.lens_source_fidelity: Re-opened all 5 cited sources. 3 CONFIRMED (cli.mjs:52 blunt copyFileSync clobbers on update; check-component-drift.mjs:62 valve is a reason-less whole-file substring test; MDN @layer confirms precedence follows layer order). TWO defects: (a) the @layer claim is INCOMPLETE — MDN says UNLAYERED styles beat any layered rule, so a satellite override escapes the lock unless it is ITSELF layered; the doc must require the override be in a lower layer. (b) Polaris custom-property-allowed-list is a token-VALIDITY check, NOT a role-to-token map — it does NOT enforce 'the correct token', so the semantic-class citation is WRONG and must be replaced.
critiqued.lens_calibration: OVER-BUILT for the real case. Only 2 consumers exist today (dashboard + sat-cristian-garcia); the kill-criteria name 3 of Option 3's own pieces (per-element model, element tagging, semantic detection) AS the failure mode at 2-3 consumers. Goal+Recommendation are written at ~100 satellites and over-sell all 5 phases. Minimum that pays NOW: Phase 1 (manifest + non-destructive update, fixes the blunt-overwrite bug) + check-raw-color + running the EXISTING drift checks as a full unconditional sweep. Phases 2-5 must be DEFERRED behind an explicit consumer-count trigger.
critiqued.lens_maintainability: Both hard pieces need REFRAMING. (a) 3-way merge needs a BASE revision — a version STRING manifest cannot merge; must pin the DS git-SHA per file and run git merge-file, emitting CONFLICT MARKERS a human resolves (shadcn punted: only experimental diff + manual apply). Rename to 'base-pinned assisted reconcile'. (b) role-to-token inference from JSX is NOT feasible (permanently-yellow gate, its own kill-criterion); but component IDENTITY is KNOWN (Button.tsx=Button, registered) — honest gate is allow-list tokens per KNOWN COMPONENT + ban raw values; 'wrong-but-valid token on a card' stays DESIGN REVIEW, not a gate.
critiqued.lens_governance: The --fleet orchestrator as written ('rolls out', 'controlled cadence') is PUSH-shaped — a central actor knowing consumer paths — which design-tokens.md:76 + ADR-027:36 (accepted) forbid as a HARD invariant (distinct from the deferrable DTCG YAGNI). Manifest + non-destructive update + @layer + gates are INSIDE governance (complete ADR-006's 'reconciliacion'). FIX: constrain --fleet to per-consumer PULL — it REPORTS drift and OPENS a PR / triggers each consumer's own em-ui update; never writes bytes into consumer paths. 'machine-generated locked layer' is imprecise: @layer needs no generator.
critiqued.completeness: Missing dimension: ROLLBACK / failure semantics of a propagated update. A design update can BREAK a consumer (build, contrast gate, VRT — satellite VRT is NOT a required check, so a satellite could regress silently). The manifest pins versions but there is no story for a consumer HOLDING a version, the rollout HALTING on first red, or REVERTING a bad update across N satellites. Add a rollout-safety facet: pinned versions + halt-on-red + per-consumer VRT before the update lands.
